subject: Re: Performance proof & amendment for Q4 capacity uplift
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@metricsly.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: metricsly-sre@metricsly.com
Date: 2027-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: performance proof + revised T&Cs for Q4 capacity uplift

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're moving toward a Q4 capacity uplift (roughly 2.3x current token volume) but the execs have pushed back: they want concrete performance proof and a short-term amendment with a pilot pricing commitment before they sign any expansion PO.

Two asks:
- A short benchmark run that demonstrates p95 latency under our 1k token median prompt profile and peak burst behavior (we can run traffic against a dedicated pool or a canary).
- A 90-day amendment template with a clearly scoped capacity band, rollback terms, and a temporary commercial concession to reflect the trial risk.

This is urgent; procurement wants something to review by Friday. Can Redwood provide a plan and a draft amendment? If we can't get proof fast our CFO says they'll push the uplift into next quarter and evaluate the competing vendor who's offering an aggressive price.

Thanks,
Elena
VP, Product Operations
Metricsly

Attachments: none (will share request template from procurement if useful)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@metricsly.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: performance proof + revised T&Cs for Q4 capacity uplift

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. We can run a focused proof-of-performance and put together a concise amendment for procurement. Proposed immediate plan:

1) Canary run: dedicated five-GPU pool for 48 hours that mirrors your 1k token profile and synthetic peak bursts; we'll instrument p50/p95/p99 and token cost delta.
2) Amendment draft: 90-day uplift band (2.0–2.5x), temporary tiered discount for committed usage during the pilot, and explicit rollback to baseline capacity. We will include SLA addendum for latency targets and an “operational exit” checklist.
3) Timeline: plan + amendment draft to you by EOD tomorrow; canary kickoff within 24–48 hours on sign-off; final report within 72 hours of run completion.

Ben and Lauren — can you please confirm feasibility (ops + commercial) and paste the amendment stub you want me to use as a starting point? I will attach the amendment and a checklist for procurement.

Priyom
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: amendment_draft_v1.docx (placeholder — internal draft)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Elena Morales <elena@metricsly.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: performance proof + revised T&Cs for Q4 capacity uplift

Priyom / Elena —

We can stand up a dedicated pool and run the benchmark. A couple of technical clarifications so we target the right signals:
- Please confirm average sequence length distribution (you said median ~1k; is 90th perc at 1.6k?).
- Do you want GPU-level KV cache warm starts (to mirror long-running sessions) or cold starts for conservative numbers?
- Are the tokens including system prompts and tool calls?

Operationally we can do a 48-hour run with traffic shaping to include peak 5-minute bursts that simulate a 1.5x concurrency spike. Deliverables: raw latency CSV, token-cost comparison vs your baseline, and an executive one-page that summarizes risk and mitigation.

I'll prepare the canary_run_instructions.md and the benchmark_report_outline.pdf and share.

-Ben
Head of Technical Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary_run_instructions.md, benchmark_report_outline.pdf

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@metricsly.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: performance proof + revised T&Cs for Q4 capacity uplift

Priyom — quick commercial note before we finalize the draft: procurement will want a clear end-of-trial reconciliation and a single line that shows the temporary unit price during the pilot. I recommend we offer a 10% pilot concession on per-token rates for the 90-day amendment, with an explicit reversion to standard rates unless a signed uplift PO is executed by the amendment expiry. Also want to confirm we can commit to a latency SLO for p95 under the canary profile (we can make it a best-effort SLO with credits tied to missed p95s).

If Elena can confirm the sequence distribution, I'll edit amendment_draft_v1.docx and send a procurement-friendly redline.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Sales Operations

Attachments: none

From: Elena Morales <elena@metricsly.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: metricsly-sre@metricsly.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-03T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: performance proof + revised T&Cs for Q4 capacity uplift

Priyom / Ben / Lauren —

Thanks — quick answers:
- Sequence length: median 1,020 tokens; 90th percentile 1,600 tokens.
- Warm cache for sustained sessions is preferred; our real traffic benefits from prefix caching.
- Tokens include system prompts and tool call overhead.

Procurement: the CFO wants the amendment and Exec summary in hand by Friday 10/06 local time. They also said they'll be evaluating the competing vendor in parallel — not a firm commitment but a clear commercial pressure.

If you can provide a short amendment with a 10% pilot concession and the operational runbook + report by Friday, we'll be able to move quickly.

Elena

Attachment: procurement_request_template.pdf (sent separately)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@metricsly.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-06T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance proof & amendment for Q4 capacity uplift — plan and next steps

Elena —

All set. Summary of agreed plan and immediate asks:

1) Canary run: 48-hour dedicated pool with warm cache, traffic profile per your distribution (median 1,020 / p90 1,600). Ben's team will kick off on 10/07 08:00 PT pending your technical signoff (reply OK).
2) Amendment: 90-day amendment with 10% pilot concession, rollback clause, and a best-effort p95 latency SLO with credit table. Lauren attached a procurement-friendly redline to the draft; I have uploaded amendment_draft_v1.docx to our shared drive and included a DocuSign link for a narrow signature if you want immediate paperwork.
3) Deliverables & timing: amendment draft + exec summary by EOD 10/06 (attached), canary instructions and kickoff 10/07, final report within 72 hours of run completion.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4982 | DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-amendment

Let me know "OK to proceed" and we'll schedule the canary windows and Ops on-call. If you'd like, we can schedule a 20-minute alignment call tomorrow to walk procurement through the amendment.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this locked in.

Priyom
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: amendment_draft_v1.docx, benchmark_report_outline.pdf
